preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 200.
The integer n must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of palindromes that can be obtained by inserting n letters into s, modulo 10007.
